warnings: House title block: 'สราญรมย์ 2' — 'แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน' series, สำนักการโยธา กรุงเทพมหานคร (same project family as house #12's '(024) ธรรมรักษา', a different design number/name in the same 100-design series). Small 2-story house, single-span RC frame (3x4 grid, 5 rows x 4 columns), full steel hip roof (อะเส 2C150x50x20x2.3mm, ตะเข้สัน/จุดตั้งดั้ง/อกไก่ 2C125x50x20x2.3mm, จันทัน C100x50x20x2.3mm@1.00m).

Main grid (x: 1-4, y: A-E) is triangulated across three independently-printed sheets that all agree exactly: the footing plan (หน้า17, the authoritative structural source), and the ground/upper architectural floor plans (หน้า03/หน้า04) — all three print the same 4.00/2.20/4.50 (x, total 10.70m) and 2.50/3.50/3.50/2.00 (y, total 11.50m) chains. High confidence.

This house's structural sheets (หน้า17-23) carry no printed sheet code (no 'S-01' style label) and no printed page number anywhere in the title block — verified by close crop, unlike house #12's set. sheet_code and doc_page are recorded as null throughout this house rather than guessed.

z_levels/dimension_chains for the z axis come from the building section (หน้า13, รูปตัด A-A) and cross-check exactly: 0.00+0.50+3.25+3.00+2.048 = 8.798, matching the printed total bracket. High confidence.

op04 scope note: only the STRUCTURAL sheets (หน้า17-23) were swept for dimension_chains/unassigned_dimensions per §4. The architectural floor/elevation/electrical/sanitary sheets (หน้า01-16, หน้า24) were used only to cross-validate the main grid figures already confirmed on หน้า17, not exhaustively transcribed for every room sub-dimension — those pages are outside op04's Pass-2 structural scope (deliberately_skipped, see _scope.json). This is a scope decision, not an unread-sheet gap.

The roof structural framing plan (หน้า18) prints its rectangle (อะเส wall-plate beam) exactly on the main grid (rows B and D, columns 1-4) — its own dimension chain (1.10 | 4.00 | 2.20 | 4.50 | 1.10 on x; 1.10 | 3.50 | 3.50 | 1.10 on y) describes the RAFTER-TAIL EAVE OVERHANG beyond that wall-plate beam, not a second set of grid lines. Per the established project rule (a roof overhang gets a dummy grid only when a discrete beam/column endpoint lands there, not for a spacing-based rafter's reach — precedent: house #12's หน้า00), the 4 printed 1.10m overhang values are recorded in unassigned_dimensions, not as new dummy grid lines. No dummy grids were needed anywhere in this house's grid master.
